desc:
🌱 Grow Your Dream Garden!

Start with a tiny patch of land and transform it into a massive, beautiful garden filled with crops, flowers, rare plants, and legendary trees!

Plant crops, watch them grow, harvest your produce, and sell it for money. Expand your land, unlock exciting new plants, hire helpful gardeners, and decorate everything your way. Your garden even keeps growing while you’re offline!

✨ FEATURES:

🌾 Discover dozens of crops and beautiful flowers
💰 Harvest, sell, upgrade, and expand
🎨 Build and decorate your garden your way
⏳ Keep growing crops while you’re offline
👨‍🌾 Hire gardeners to harvest automatically
🌳 Unlock rare plants and legendary trees
🦋 Attract visitors and wildlife to your garden

🌻 How big and beautiful will your garden become?
